race.comment: PINK VIXEN (10) made it two wins on the bounce when she led all the way to defeat her own age over the mile at Eagle Farm 17 days ago. Doesn't face the strongest Saturday field here and with the claim she looks well in. Prepared to say she can do it again. PIPISTRELLE (2) has a fine strike rate, enhanced last time out when she saluted in a comparable race to this here a fortnight ago. Needs every bit of Kendal's 3kgs claim. Draws the fence and should run another big race. SLIPSAIN (18) tried hard but just failed to pick up PIPISTRELLE here recently. Only meets her 0.5kgs better and draws the car park so a couple of negatives, but his solid recent efforts are too good to ignore. RIEZ SOUVENT (11) disappointed when tested over 1800m at Eagle Farm last time. Deserves another chance back to this trip with the blinkers reapplied.
